title: Remote viewing used to trade silver futures

tellings.quote: can go back and the next day on the average you get get your money we ran 70 30 instead of 50 50.

plain: Remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant or future things with the mind alone, was once used to bet on silver futures, according to a researcher named Hal Puthoff, billed on the show as a CIA UFO expert. Puthoff tells Michels he took part, and says the predictions came out right about 70 percent of the time instead of the 50 percent of a coin toss, with the money coming in the next day. If true, it would mean the method could beat chance in the market.
